# Knowledge Compiler CLI

The Knowledge Compiler CLI provides a command-line interface for compiling engineering artifacts into a knowledge base. It supports various commands such as initializing a repository, compiling changes, reconciling updates, verifying consistency, inspecting the state, validating tests, and serving the compiled knowledge.
